heroCopy: WHITEROCK COMPANY LIMITED operates a stone manufacturing site in Binh Phuoc Province, Vietnam. Owner-supplied photos show stone cutting and processing equipment, production staging, vanity-top preparation, inspection, and packing activity.

retailerAudits.intro: The factory status and named audit programs are based on owner-supplied information. Certificate numbers, grades, validity dates, product scope, and downloadable source documents remain pending owner upload. SCAN and the QSA / EQA title must be checked against the original certificates before final publication.

capabilities.title: Common and Custom Sizes
capabilities.copy: Common vanity and countertop dimensions can be quoted together with custom cut-to-size work. Final dimensions follow approved drawings.

capabilities.title: Sink Cutout and Assembly Options
capabilities.copy: Cutouts and optional assembly are quoted against the buyer-approved sink model, mounting detail, and required documentation.

capabilities.title: Edge and Waterfall Details
capabilities.copy: Eased, bevel, bullnose, laminated, mitered, and other edge details are reviewed by drawing and sample.

capabilities.title: Commercial Drawing Support
capabilities.copy: The team can review bills of quantities, unit schedules, shop drawings, labeling, and packing sequences for quotation.

flowSteps.title: Material and Batch Review
flowSteps.copy: Material, color range, finish, thickness, and batch acceptance are agreed before production.

flowSteps.title: Cutting and Machining
flowSteps.copy: Stone components are cut and machined from the approved drawings and templates.

flowSteps.title: Edge and Assembly Preparation
flowSteps.copy: Edges, openings, loose components, and optional assembly work are prepared to the order specification.

flowSteps.title: Inspection and Packing
flowSteps.copy: Inspection records, labels, protective materials, and packing method follow the agreed quality and packing plan.

inspectionPoints: Material, color range, and thickness against the approved sample
Overall dimensions and cutouts against approved drawings
Faucet-hole and sink alignment where applicable
Dry-lay or fit check when specified by the buyer
Packing, labels, and crate checklist before dispatch
qc.aql: Sampling method, acceptance limits, and rework rules must be agreed in the purchase order or quality plan.
qc.tools: Inspection tools and calibration requirements are selected for the agreed dimensions and acceptance criteria.
qc.thirdParty: Buyer-appointed third-party inspection can be discussed before order confirmation.

capabilities: Project mock-ups and sample kits by quotation
Private-label packaging and barcode requirements by quotation
Custom packing development for the confirmed product
rnd.sampleLeadTime: Sample availability, cost, and timing are confirmed after material and drawing review.

materials.copy: Natural and engineered stone selections are confirmed by color, finish, thickness, format, approved sample, and supplier availability.
materials.traceability: Batch records, labels, and inspection documentation are agreed for each order.

packing.copy: Protective materials, cartons, crates, racks, labels, moisture protection, and bracing are selected for the confirmed product and transport route.
packing.loadability: Container loading quantity and payload are calculated from the final bill of materials and packing plan.
